item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 04/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The broad trough of low pressure over the central and southern parts of the South China Sea is expected to develop gradually and move northwards. It will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 05/06 (Monday)
Wind: East to southeast force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Sunny periods and a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms in the morning.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
